```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

alpha <- read_csv("bicyclist_alpha_2014_2023.csv")
beta <- read_csv("bicyclist_beta_2014_2023.csv")

alpha_clean <- alpha %>%
  mutate(
    YEAR = year(COLLISION_DATE),
    MONTH = month(COLLISION_DATE),
    DAY_OF_WEEK = wday(COLLISION_DATE, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE),
    DAY_OF_WEEK = factor(DAY_OF_WEEK, levels = c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun")),
    HOUR = case_when(
      COLLISION_TIME >= 2300 ~ 23,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 2200 ~ 22,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 2100 ~ 21,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 2000 ~ 20,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 1900 ~ 19,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 1800 ~ 18,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 1700 ~ 17,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 1600 ~ 16,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 1500 ~ 15,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 1400 ~ 14,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 1300 ~ 13,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 1200 ~ 12,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 1100 ~ 11,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 1000 ~ 10,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 900 ~ 9,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 800 ~ 8,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 700 ~ 7,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 600 ~ 6,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 500 ~ 5,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 400 ~ 4,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 300 ~ 3,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 200 ~ 2,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 100 ~ 1,
      COLLISION_TIME >= 0 ~ 0 
    )
  )

collisions <- left_join(alpha_clean, beta, by = "CASE_ID")
```

# Trend Analysis

## Column {width=35%}

### { .valuebox }
```{r}
#| title: "Total Collisions"
list(
  icon = "bicycle",
  color = "primary",
  value = nrow(collisions)
)
```

### { .valuebox }
```{r}
#| title: "Fatal Collisions"
list(
  icon = "exclamation-triangle",
  color = "danger",
  value = sum(collisions$NUMBER_KILLED > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
)
```

## Column {width=65%}

### Long-term Trends

```{r}
trend_plot <- collisions %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = n(),
    Fatal = sum(NUMBER_KILLED > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Total, color = "All Collisions"), size = 1.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Fatal, color = "Fatal Collisions"), size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Total, color = "All Collisions"), size = 2) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Fatal, color = "Fatal Collisions"), size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("All Collisions" = "#1f77b4", "Fatal Collisions" = "#d62728")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(title = "Bicyclist Collisions Over Time (2014-2023)",
       y = "Count",
       x = "Year",
       color = "Outcome")

ggplotly(trend_plot)
```

### Killed-to-Injured Ratio Over Time

```{r}
ratio_plot <- collisions %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Killed = sum(NUMBER_KILLED, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Injured = sum(NUMBER_INJURED, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(Ratio = Total_Killed / Total_Injured) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR, y = Ratio)) +
  geom_line(color = "#ff7f0e", size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "#d62728", size = 2.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "#ff7f0e", alpha = 0.2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(title = "Ratio of Killed to Injured Bicyclists (2014-2023)",
       y = "Killed/Injured Ratio",
       x = "Year")

ggplotly(ratio_plot)
```

# Comparison & Details

## Row

### Collision Types by Severity

```{r}
severity_facet_plot <- collisions %>%
  mutate(Severity = ifelse(NUMBER_KILLED > 0, "Fatal", "Non-Fatal")) %>%
  group_by(Severity, TYPE_OF_COLLISION) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(TYPE_OF_COLLISION, Count), y = Count, fill = Severity)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~Severity, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Fatal" = "#d62728", "Non-Fatal" = "#1f77b4")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(title = "Collision Types by Outcome Severity", x = "Collision Type", y = "Count", fill = "Outcome")

ggplotly(severity_facet_plot)
```

## Row

### Collision Types: Injured Bicyclists Ranking

```{r}
injury_ranking <- collisions %>%
  group_by(TYPE_OF_COLLISION) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Injured = sum(NUMBER_INJURED, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_Injured))

injury_plot <- injury_ranking %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(TYPE_OF_COLLISION, Total_Injured), y = Total_Injured, fill = Total_Injured)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#fee5d9", high = "#a1d99b") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Collision Types: Total Injured Bicyclists", x = "Collision Type", y = "Total Injured")

ggplotly(injury_plot)
```

### Collision Types: Deaths Ranking

```{r}
killed_ranking <- collisions %>%
  group_by(TYPE_OF_COLLISION) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Killed = sum(NUMBER_KILLED, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_Killed))

killed_plot <- killed_ranking %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(TYPE_OF_COLLISION, Total_Killed), y = Total_Killed, fill = Total_Killed)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#fee0b6", high = "#d62728") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Collision Types: Total Deaths", x = "Collision Type", y = "Total Killed")

ggplotly(killed_plot)
```

## Row

### Summary Statistics by Collision Type

```{r}
summary_table <- collisions %>%
  group_by(TYPE_OF_COLLISION) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Collisions = n(),
    Total_Killed = sum(NUMBER_KILLED, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Injured = sum(NUMBER_INJURED, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_Killed_Per_Collision = round(mean(NUMBER_KILLED, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Avg_Injured_Per_Collision = round(mean(NUMBER_INJURED, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_Collisions))

kable(summary_table, format = "html", digits = 3) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    font_size = 11,
    full_width = TRUE
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  kableExtra::row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#1f77b4", color = "white")
```
